name: Cernay-lès-Reims Open 2026
information: L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€. Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CernaylesReimsOpen2026#66159-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet **[Planning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CernaylesReimsOpen2026#competition-schedule)**. ---- Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€. Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CernaylesReimsOpen2026#66159-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the **[Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CernaylesReimsOpen2026#competition-schedule) tab**.
